project_name: J B KEER Adhesive Consultant Landing Page
archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Corporate Industrial B2B
design_philosophy: Corporate Indian B2B trust combined with modern clarity. High white space, strong typography, restrained color palette anchored by brand deep navy and teal. Clean grid layouts reflecting engineering precision and 40 years of legacy. Avoids startup/SaaS tropes; focuses on industrial legacy and credibility.

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8

surfaces_and_borders.cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-none shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300

components_instructions.navigation: Sticky top navigation (z-50) using glassmorphism. Left: Logo. Center: Links (Services, Industries, About, Process). Right: 'Book Consultancy' button with data-testid='nav-book-consultancy'.
components_instructions.hero: Split layout or full width with heavy gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Use 'hero_industrial' image in background. H1: '40 Years of Excellence in Industrial Adhesives'. Sub: 'Born to Bond. Precision adhesives, construction chemicals, and expert consultancy for B2B enterprises.' Primary CTA: 'Book Consultancy' with data-testid='hero-book-consultancy'.
components_instructions.stats_bar: Dense, Control Room style grid. Dark background (#1A172B). 40+ Years Experience, 1200+ Projects Delivered. High contrast white and teal text.
components_instructions.services_grid: Bento grid layout. Use generated macro photography for cards. Include: Industrial Adhesives, Construction Chemicals, Waterproofing, Sealants, Wood Bonding, Expert Consultancy. Cards should have solid backgrounds, sharp edges, and clear typographic hierarchy.
components_instructions.industries_served: Horizontal scrolling or tight grid. Minimal icons or text-heavy list with borders. Furniture, Construction, Packaging, Automotive, Footwear, Textile.
components_instructions.process: Step-by-step numbered list layout. Focus on the consultancy aspect (Audit -> Formulation -> Application -> Support). Use 1px borders and large typography numbers.
components_instructions.contact_form: Shadcn UI Form at the bottom. Fields: Name, Email, Phone, Company, Project Type (Select), Message. Button: Full width brand_teal with data-testid='contact-form-submit'.
components_instructions.footer: Dark background. Include contact details: Phone (+91 9850858558), Website (www.jbkeer.com), Address (Pune). Quick links. 'Born to Bond' tagline.

trust_background.description: Corporate handshake for Why Choose Us section

testing_requirements.attributes: All interactive elements must use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-book-consultancy', data-testid='contact-form-submit', data-testid='service-card-*')
